name: resonance
description: Search albums and tracks across providers, starting with slskd
author: carlba

scripts.linux:install: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -e CI="true" -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:24-bullseye bash -lc "corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.5.1 --activate && pnpm install"
scripts.linux:ci: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -e CI="true" -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:24-bullseye bash -lc "corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.5.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build"
